note: Table 7K and Table 7M are NOT occupancy tables (unlike 7A-7J). They give the base water-quantity/pump-capacity calculation for a given protection LEVEL CODE (CL-x or HL-x) referenced by Table 7A-7J bands. Group K (Mixed Use) has no dedicated Table 7 letter - per clause 3.1.11.2, mixed-occupancy zones are governed by the union of the component occupancies' Table 7 requirements, with the most restrictive occupancy governing each overlapping zone.

table_7k_combined_protection.table_name: Table 7K - Base Calculations for Combined Protection System (Sprinkler System and Hose Stream)

units.sprinkler_demand: sqm equivalent design density factor (litre/min per sqm basis)

table_7k_combined_protection.worked_example: For CL-5: capacity = (12.2 x 230) + (475 x 3) = 4231 litre; with 20 percent overflow margin = 5077.2 litre; pump selection = 5077.2 / 140 x 100 = 3627 lpm, rounded to the nearest Indian Standard pump size of 3785 lpm.
table_7k_combined_protection.pump_sizing_formula: Total flow with 20 percent overflow margin, operating at 140 percent capacity.
notes: 'Pump' implies an electric pump plus a standby pump of equivalent capacity. A jockey pump is also required for loss-in-pressure compensation.
Firefighting duration may be decided from 30 to 120 min based on hazard, fire preparedness, local conditions, etc.
Required water quantity may alternatively be calculated per the respective Indian Standards where available.

table_7m_hose_stream_only.table_name: Table 7M - Base Calculations for Hose Stream Protection System
table_7m_hose_stream_only.worked_example: For HL-3: capacity = 270 x 4 = 1080 litre; with 40 percent overflow margin = 1512 litre; pump selection = 1512 / 140 x 100 = 1514 lpm (nearest Indian Standard pump).
table_7m_hose_stream_only.pump_sizing_formula: Total flow with 40 percent overflow margin, operating at 140 percent capacity.
notes: 'Pump' implies an electric pump plus a standby pump of equivalent capacity. A jockey pump is also required for loss-in-pressure compensation.
Firefighting duration may be decided from 30 to 120 min based on hazard, fire preparedness, local conditions, etc.
Required water quantity may alternatively be calculated per the respective Indian Standards where available.
